description: Implementation of the Tourism Development Projects 2026-2028
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Tourism Development Programme has been prepared to be implemented during the period 2026-2028 covering 9 provinces, identifying destinations with tourism potential in Sri Lanka and paying attention to the development of their infrastructure in order to ensure a sustainable tourism industry. The total gross estimate for the same is Rs. 2,667.03 million. Similarly, the Department of National Planning has granted approval to implement projects with an estimated cost of Rs. 131.02 million for the development of tourism infrastructure in the Jaffna District. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to implement the said tourism development programme during the period 2026-2028 and to implement the tourism infrastructure development project in the Jaffna District in the year 2026, was approved by the Cabinet.
